title: Consumer lockfile
description: Written into a consuming app (ui.lock.json, repo root) by `npx @bydiorama/ui sync`. One entry per installed registry item: the revision it came from, plus a content hash per installed file at that moment. The hash is what distinguishes STALE (upstream moved, consumer didn't touch it) from MODIFIED (consumer edited it on purpose) -- without it every drift report is noise (plan.md §4.6).

registry.description: Where items were installed from: a base URL (raw.githubusercontent.com/.../r) or a local filesystem path to a bydiorama/ui checkout, whichever `sync` was run with.

revision.description: Git commit SHA of bydiorama/ui this item was installed or last synced from.

lockedAt.description: When this item was last locked at `revision` -- the cutoff for "which ledger entries are new since I last looked".

files.description: Keyed by the file's target path in the consumer app (matches the registry item's `files[].target`). Value is `sha256:<hex>` of the file's content at lock time.
